reproduction.rationale: Selected method endpoint is shared by reproduction and improvement. Both arms receive the same paper, admitted original observations, neutral input interface, source-defined preprocessing representation, full evaluation support and resource/access ceilings. Paper and published values are permitted observations but cannot prove computation. Paper_data receives no official algorithm implementation, source-derived solution, fitted decoder or private reference output. Paper_data_author_code adds only an immutable official endpoint-code package. Provenance inventories and source links are not participant allowlists. Exact file-level inventories, leakage review, code isolation and cumulative ceilings remain unresolved. Exact authentic input, evaluator, exposure, reference and cumulative-budget bindings are absent; no outcome is admitted.
